title: Trace MNIST download and CSV preparation
description: You inspect mirror fallbacks, binary readers, and the recorded setup failure.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You define three download mirrors and four compressed MNIST filenames. The active output paths are relative directories under ./mnist_data and ./kaggle/input/digit-recognizer.
You reuse an existing destination or try the mirrors in order. Each failed request records its exception; exhausting the list raises RuntimeError.
You define compressed IDX readers for images and labels. Their header checks require the respective format's magic number.
You flatten image arrays into pixel columns for CSV writing. The training writer inserts a label column, while the test writer includes pixels only.

steps.question: Does the recorded setup reach the training CSV writer?
steps.answer: All mirrors fail for the first image file with name-resolution errors. The raised exception reaches the outer handler before the readers and writers run.

steps.description: You see three mirror-failure messages followed by the MNIST-SETUP error. The supplied recording reports a failed download rather than a completed CSV export.
